deadline_policy: Conservative four-hour engineering hard stop, including final reporting/testing; at expiry select one allowed outcome, no extension request.
purpose: Retrospective diagnosis only; old holdout is already seen, never new validation.

selection.rule: Exactly the prior31 unique COMBAT_REQUIRED cases; symmetric replay without filtering original outcomes. Legacy4 remain aliases and add0.

formula.name: fight_ordinary
formula.attacker_morale: retained force.accelerated; unique pinned known-leg ETA inversion only when directly observed flag is absent
formula.defender_morale: target tower morale at before tick
formula.source_current_morale: supplementary context only; never substituted for force.accelerated

qualification.rules: Unchanged prior hostility-known, inbound-complete, production/aura/special/delay/capacity/continuity guards. Recompute only with existing frozen scorer and assert per-case agreement; no relaxation, reachability exclusion, or repaired endpoint.

continuation_accounting: Predicted owner must equal observed owner AND predicted survivor vector must equal observed inventory + SUM(all compatible newly observable outgoing at offset0). Preserve partial retained inventory and partial outgoing; no subset search, clipping, or outgoing==survivor requirement. Known source-target oversized vectors stay included as counterexamples.
compatible_outgoing: Same first-retained document/match/player/time-origin scope and arrival tick; known source==combat target, known owner==observed post-combat owner, complete known nonnegative typed vector. Destination may remain UNKNOWN. No amount/budget filter. Count new signature multiplicity above before baseline, using owner/source/destination/vector; IDs supplemental only. Same signature persisting across frames is not counted again. Unknown before endpoint/vector aliases flag uncertain first appearance.
unknown_policy: Missing/incomplete census or plausible same-observed-owner unknown source/owner/vector prevents complete NO or complete accounting; never substitute zero. Preserve a separate observed-only arithmetic result. Do not use formula survivor size to discard unknown-source aliases. Relevant before-alias uncertainty also remains UNKNOWN. Known owner mismatch or known vector contradiction is a true mismatch only if relevant accounting inputs are complete.
timing: offset0=arrival; +1/+2 extracted from existing pinned raw sources are EXPLORATORY and cannot change primary score, flips, or verdict. Same known four-part scope and consecutive ticks mandatory.

scoring.primary_status: EXACT, MISMATCH, UNKNOWN; owner and vector accounted separately.
scoring.outgoing_status: YES if a known new compatible member exists; NO only with complete census/newness excluding plausible aliases; otherwise UNKNOWN. YES may still have UNKNOWN accounting completeness.
scoring.flip_direction: EXACT against original MISMATCH -> MISMATCH_TO_MATCH; MISMATCH against original MATCH -> MATCH_TO_MISMATCH; known unchanged -> NONE; any indeterminate -> UNKNOWN. Count both directions over all31 and report qualified subset separately.
scoring.known_counterexample: Existing qualified case whose original and aware accounting both mismatch with known relevant fields OR original qualified MATCH genuinely becomes known aware MISMATCH.

controls.sampling: Smallest SHA256(salt|group|cohort|before_sequence|target_id) ranks. Freeze pool rules before detector runs. Never select by observed outgoing/accounting result. Retain sampled UNKNOWNs; do not replace them.

A.pool: Existing comparable consecutive raw/audit edges and before-visible ordinary nonneutral towers with known positive inventory. Certify no due visible arrival to this tower using existing before-known destination and ETA/current-leg audit; any potentially incoming force unresolved prevents non-arrival certification. No after-outcome filters or projection-match filtering.
A.false_positive: Known same-tick outgoing detection on certified non-arrival control is background positive for the event-association claim; not proof that source extraction is wrong. Report YES/NO/UNKNOWN and eligible pool size.
A.gate: Known positives/N >10% -> mandatory INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION. Accept only when (known positives+UNKNOWN)/N <=10% and N>=90; otherwise insufficient controls.

B.pool: All264 supported existing EMPTY_NEUTRAL_CAPTURE or SAME_OWNER_REINFORCEMENT arrivals; sample without using their MATCH/MISMATCH outcome. No new noncombat simulator or reinforcement expansion.
B.actual_target: Apply identical detector to the actual noncombat arrival target. Report compatible outgoing YES/NO/UNKNOWN rate; genuine noncombat continuation is not automatically a false-positive.
B.paired_specificity_control: For each sampled arrival choose a deterministic same-owner before-visible ordinary decoy tower (prefer observed neighbor, else other visible tower), with no certified due arrival, excluding the actual target. Keep event and decoy identities distinct; never substitute the arrival target. This tests accidental pairing of nearby arrival/outgoing. Missing decoy is UNKNOWN, not synthetic evidence.
B.false_pairing: Detector-positive on the independently non-arriving paired decoy is the B background/mispair statistic. >10% known positives -> mandatory INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION; acceptance requires (positive+UNKNOWN)/available_decoys<=10% and >=20 available decoys. Report actual-target presence separately so generic true continuation is not mislabeled as detector error.

outcomes.mandatory_hard_stops: Control failure, second definition revision, prohibited information need, or time expiry -> INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION. Otherwise test FALSIFIED first, then SUPPORTED, else INSUFFICIENT.
outcomes.FORMULA_FALSIFIED: At least1 qualified fully-known counterexample as frozen above. No formula edit this round.
outcomes.FORMULA_DIAGNOSTICALLY_SUPPORTED: At least4/5 original mismatches become primary complete EXACT; zero true original-MATCH->MISMATCH; zero qualified fully-known residual mismatch; unchanged4 qualified cases remain complete exact (avoid vacuous qualification); controls pass; no second definition revision. Still diagnostic only, no credit.
outcomes.INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION: Every other situation; next improved-field prospective passive recording, never another replay of old corpus.

previously_inspected: Audit existing reports/tools to answer YES/NO/UNKNOWN. This does not create diagnostic independence.
